_scenario: A three-bone rig (hip → knee → foot, ordinary Bone nodes under a Group skin root) posed by one looping 2 s AnimationClip through one AnimationMixer over a composite { skeleton, morph } target: a quaternion track slerping the hip a quarter-turn and back (path skeleton.bones.0.transform.rotation), a linear vector3 track translating the knee (skeleton.bones.1.transform.position), and a linear number track ramping one MorphWeights element (morph.weights.1) — §17's skeletal-joint and morph-weight entries, exercised as the binding forms they are. 600 clean 1/60 s frames through Application's fixed-step scheduler with an AnimationSystem at §39 step 3; after every step Skeleton.update rewrites the palette (insertion-order bone walk, fixed association order) and the digest is an FNV-1a checksum (plan D6, 1e-6 quantization) over the 48 palette floats plus the 2 morph weights, in that fixed order.
_tier: §33 same-runtime. The quaternion track slerps (§17's fifth interpolation mode), and slerp's acos/sin are not pinned to the last bit by ECMA-262 — phase4's recorded reason, unchanged. The palette itself is products and one inversion over those values; the vector and number tracks are exact IEEE lerps. The palette is the LAST value inside the §33 envelope: vertex deformation happens in the GPU vertex stage, outside it by construction, and no engine API returns skinned vertex positions (RFC 0003 §6).
